include_yields.description: If true, cross-reference results with DeFiLlama yield farming pools for the identified tokens. Adds ~1s latency. Default false.

korean_only.description: If true, returns only the Korean Upbit data (faster, omits CoinGecko global movers). Default false.

limit.description: Number of tokens to return per source (1–20). Default 10.

mode.description: Ranking mode: 'gainers' (top 24h % up), 'losers' (top 24h % down), 'volume' (highest 24h USD volume). Default: gainers.

Returns top gaining/losing/volume-leading tokens on Upbit (Korea's #1 exchange), global CoinGecko movers, and matching DeFi yield pools when include_yields is true. Korean volume often leads global crypto moves — use for pre-trade momentum confirmation, cross-exchange alpha identification, and DeFi capital allocation.
